mainEntity.name: What is actually inside an EdinCard slot?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sealed, factory-fresh Pokémon TCG product. Nothing is opened, resealed, weighed or swapped before it goes into a machine. Every slot is labelled with exactly what it dispenses.

mainEntity.name: How do I pay at an EdinCard machine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Contactless card, Apple Pay or Google Pay at the machine. There is no cash slot, no account to create and no app to install.

mainEntity.name: What happens if a pack does not drop?

acceptedAnswer.text: Email info@edincardvending.com within 48 hours with the machine location, the slot code and the approximate time. We check the vend log and arrange a replacement or a refund.

EdinCard's first machine is going into Edinburgh Waverley station (Waverley Station, Edinburgh EH1 1BB) and is not yet taking payments. Further machines are being placed in host venues across Edinburgh — game shops, cafés, collectible stores, arcades and student venues. Each machine is listed on the Locations page from the day it goes live.

mainEntity.name: Can I put an EdinCard machine in my venue?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. EdinCard supplies, installs, insures, stocks and services the machine, and the host venue takes a share of every vend. There is no stock for the venue to buy or manage.

mainEntity.name: Is there a minimum age to buy from an EdinCard machine?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Trading cards are not age-restricted product, and EdinCard machines dispense a named item for a fixed price — they are not gambling machines and there is no random-prize mechanic.
